title: SOAP CONSTELLATION
description: A pressure-coupled constellation of soap cells. Bubble geometry relaxes under surface tension while the final full-resolution material resolves Plateau-like seams, thin-film interference and microscopic pearlescent grain.

visual_finish.material_model: transparent soap film with interference colour and pressure-dependent seams
